label: Bible Study
prompt: Glory to God in the _____, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verse: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
note: The angels' song over Bethlehem's shepherds — the original Gloria in Excelsis.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I _____ you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
verse: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
note: From your first day to your hoar hairs, God promises to carry you — no retirement age on this one.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and _____ of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
verse: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
note: Esau traded his birthright for 'pottage of lentiles' — history's most expensive bowl of lentil stew.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For they have sown the _____, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
verse: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
note: Hosea on Israel's idols and foreign alliances: plant nothing but air and you'll harvest a storm.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the _____ that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verse: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
note: Saved 'to the uttermost' — completely, all the way through — because he 'ever liveth to make intercession.'
